info.title: Push Lap Growth API
info.description: API for managing affiliates, referrals, and sales for SaaS businesses

get.summary: Get all affiliates or by ID/email
get.description: Returns an Affiliate By ID or Email. If none is specified, all Affiliates from the Affiliate Program are returned.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the affiliate to retrieve

parameters.name: email
parameters.description: The email of the affiliate to retrieve

200.description: A list of affiliates or a single affiliate

post.description: Creates a new affiliate on your Afffiliate Program.

put.description: Updates an Affiliate based on their ID

delete.description: Deletes an Affiliate based on the ID provided

get.summary: Get all referrals or by ID/email/externalId
get.description: Returns a list of referrals based on the affiliate program, filtered by optional referral ID, affiliate ID, affiliate email, or external ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the referral to retrieve

parameters.name: affiliateId
parameters.description: The affiliate ID associated with the referral

parameters.name: affiliateEmail
parameters.description: The email of the affiliate associated with the referral

parameters.name: externalId
parameters.description: The external ID of the referred user

200.description: A list of referrals or a single referral

post.description: Creates a new referral under the specified affiliate program. You must provide either an affiliateId, affiliateEmail, or promoCode to identify the affiliate. When using a promo code, it will be validated for expiration, redemption limits, and active status.

put.description: Updates a referral based on their ID

delete.description: Deletes a referral based on the ID provided

get.summary: Get all affiliate links or by ID/link/affiliate
get.description: Returns a list of affiliate links based on the affiliate program, filtered by optional link ID, link string, affiliate ID, or affiliate email

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the affiliate link to retrieve

parameters.name: link
parameters.description: The link string of the affiliate link to retrieve

parameters.name: affiliateId
parameters.description: The affiliate ID to get links for

parameters.name: affiliateEmail
parameters.description: The email of the affiliate to get links for

200.description: A list of affiliate links or a single affiliate link

post.description: Creates a new affiliate link for the specified affiliate. Note: an Affiliate is required to create an Affiliate Link.

put.summary: Update an affiliate link by ID or link string
put.description: Updates an affiliate link based on their ID or link string

delete.description: Deletes an affiliate link based on the ID or link string provided

get.summary: Get all coupons or by ID/externalId/name
get.description: Returns coupons based on the affiliate program. Coupons define the discount structure (amount, type, duration) that promotional codes will use.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the coupon to retrieve

parameters.name: externalId
parameters.description: The external ID of the coupon (e.g., Stripe coupon ID)

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: The name of the coupon to retrieve

200.description: A list of coupons or a single coupon

post.description: Creates a new coupon definition that can be used to generate promotional codes. Coupons define the discount structure.

put.description: Updates an existing coupon. Changes will affect all promotional codes using this coupon.

delete.description: Deletes a coupon and all associated promotional codes. This action is permanent.

get.summary: Get all promotional codes or by ID/code/couponId/affiliateId
get.description: Returns promotional codes based on the affiliate program. Promotional codes are the actual discount codes customers use at checkout.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the promotional code to retrieve

parameters.name: code
parameters.description: The promotional code string to retrieve

parameters.name: externalId
parameters.description: The external ID (e.g., Stripe promotion code ID)

parameters.name: couponId
parameters.description: Get all promotional codes for a specific coupon

parameters.name: affiliateId
parameters.description: Get all promotional codes for a specific affiliate

parameters.name: affiliateEmail
parameters.description: Get all promotional codes for an affiliate by email

200.description: A list of promotional codes or a single promotional code

post.description: Creates a new promotional code linked to a coupon. Supports both manual codes and auto-generated codes based on structure.

put.description: Updates an existing promotional code's properties like activation status, expiration, and limits.

delete.description: Deletes a promotional code. This action is permanent.

get.summary: Get all sales or by ID, affiliate, referral, or external ID
get.description: Returns a list of sales based on the affiliate program, filtered by optional sale ID, affiliate ID, affiliate email, referral ID, or external ID

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of the sale to retrieve

parameters.name: affiliateId
parameters.description: The affiliate ID associated with the sale

parameters.name: affiliateEmail
parameters.description: The email of the affiliate associated with the sale

parameters.name: referralId
parameters.description: The referral ID associated with the sale

parameters.name: saleExternalId
parameters.description: The external ID of the sale

200.description: A list of sales or a single sale

post.description: Creates a new sale under the specified affiliate program. You must provide either a referralId, email, or promoCode to identify the affiliate and referral. When using a promo code, it will be validated for expiration, redemption limits, and active status.

put.description: Updates a sale based on their ID

delete.description: Deletes a sale based on the ID provided
